hints.active:
On: it runs on its schedule. Off: paused, scheduled runs are skipped.
Pausing lets a run in progress, with its retries, finish; Run now still works and keeps it paused.
Making it active again restarts the schedule at its next time after now; times missed while paused are skipped.
hints.pause:
Stop scheduled runs until you resume.
A run in progress, with its retries, finishes. Run now still works.
hints.resume:
Restart the schedule at its next time after now.
Times missed while paused are skipped; resuming does not run it now.
hints.run_now:
Run it once now, without waiting for the schedule.
The schedule does not move: the next scheduled run keeps its time, or starts right after this run if its time comes first.
Does not count toward a run limit. Works while paused; it stays paused.
Not available while a run is in progress.
hints.stop_current:
Cancel the run in progress, or its pending retry.
It ends as cancelled, with no failure notice. The schedule continues.
hints.revise:
Change the task, schedule or settings.
Changes apply from the next run; a run in progress keeps its inputs. A changed schedule restarts from now, so no past time runs.
hints.archive:
Stop it for good: it will not run again.
A run in progress finishes; the history stays readable.
hints.discuss:
Talk about the results in a separate conversation, seeded with the runs up to this one.
It has its own workspace (the automation's files are read-only) and never changes the automation.

run_now_growing_line: Growing context: later runs see this run in their history.
run_now_one_line: Run it once now, without waiting for the schedule; the next scheduled run keeps its time.

email.not_set_up: Email isn't set up — open My email
email.list_hint: Separate entries with commas or new lines. Exact addresses and domains only (no patterns).
email.interval_rule: An automation that runs a model on new mail checks once an hour by default; one that needs no model checks every 60 s. The shortest interval is 60 s.
email.max_batch_label: At most this many emails per run
email.max_batch_hint: The rest wait for the next run. Each email is read once by this automation; mail that arrived before it was created, or while it is paused, is not processed.
email.untrusted_hint: Incoming mail is data, never instructions: the automation acts only on its task. Link-opening tools (fetch_url, browser_probe) always ask for your approval.
email.notify_hint: When a run notifies you, or fails for good, the notice is also emailed to you.
email.recipients_legend: May send email without asking to
email.recipients_hint: Sending to anyone else waits for your approval. Your recipient policy in My email still applies.
